programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bounty Baby
programme.desc: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joining the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Facebooked
programme.desc: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But Dog discovers a new source; "Facebook".

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mano-a-Mano
programme.desc: Back in Colorado, Dog's on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.sub-title: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.desc: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Comeback Kid
programme.desc: Dog is back in Colorado chasing a young man with a taste for trouble. He's fled to Texas but with his family's house on the line Dog is willing to try a risky strategy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tent City
programme.desc: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dead of Night
programme.desc: Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programme.desc: Dog launches a high stake hunt through the desolate and dangerous mountain landscape of western Colorado in pursuit of a gun-loving survivalist with a million dollar bond on his head. Will Dog's plan of using brains over brawn work?

programme.desc: Dog is committed to saving his new friend's bail bonding business, and now must race against time to bring a rogues gallery to justice in the High Sierra mountain town of Montrose, CO.

programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: His twisted observations of life, the world around him, and particularly how he has managed to screw it up, have earned John a reputation as one of the most consistently strong acts wherever he goes.

programme.title: Joe Larson
programme.desc: Joe Larson, the son of a working comedian, started comedy at an early age and has always had a knack for making light of any situation

programme.title: Tommy Ryman
programme.desc: Tommy Ryman grew up with a new-age, folk singing mother and a traditional, Lutheran insurance-agent father. This XY equation evidently equals: acclaimed comedian. Ryman has earned the title of Semifinalist on NBC's Last Comic Standing. Roseanne Barr, a professed fan, raves she has “never seen anything like Tommy before in her whole life, he is one-of-a-kind, fantastic!” Ryman also recently won the title of Best of the Midwest at the prestigious Gilda's Laugh Fest. Ryman's act can be described as absurdist and clever, masked behind a very likable and innocent demeanor, often thought of as awkwardly charming. He is a favorite among audiences at top clubs, corporates, and colleges around the nation.

programme.title: Jordan Makin
programme.desc: Born and raised in the heart of Utah County, Jordan Makin had to compensate for his red hair and uneventful childhood by learning to be funny. His unique observations will make you laugh and his stories about feeling awkward will help you appreciate your life more. He has worked with many comedy greats, such as Marc Maron, Ryan Hamilton, and Drew Lynch. His comedy has been featured at the Finger Lakes Comedy Festival and the Idaho Laugh Fest. Jordan is the co-creator and co-host of The Happy Valley Podcast.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E05 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.desc: S06E02 The Faces of Valais. Valais is Switzerland's 3rd largest Canton. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Designed for Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programme.title: Hitler's Highways
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programme.title: The Industry of War
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programme.title: A Culture of Control
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programme.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programme.title: Retreat from Reality
programme.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Rising Sun
programme.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country
programme.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: Tequila
programme.desc: Tequila and Bobo hit the little town of Chedron intending to rob the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to freeze out all the ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

programme.title: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die

programme.title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
programme.desc: Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: A judge encounters a man (Frank Latimore) he once wronged after an Apache attack. The attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

programme.title: Sabata the Killer
programme.desc: Sabata and Mangosta are bank robbers, who after a bank job, through a series of events, end up teaming up with the bank clerk, Peter. They then go on the run with Peter's boss and a hired posse equipped with the latest technology in weapons on their trail.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: Three Ruthless Ones
programme.desc: The Walker brothers took different paths—one an outlaw, one a Marshal, one a rancher. Yet they share one goal: avenging their father’s murder. When they finally find the killer, their clashing ideals lead to a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: My Gun is the Law
programme.desc: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad - until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town’s respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

programme.title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
programme.desc: Johnny Dark returns from his gold mine and lands in a deadly crooked card game. Framed and hunted by bounty killer Stack, he’s wounded and taken in by the McGovern family - only to be caught in their land war against a ruthless railroad agent. As loyalties shift, Johnny’s past and fate collide.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und Patzer
programme.desc: In dieser Folge gibt es die besten Outtakes, Versprecher, Patzer und Lachanfälle aus 70 Folgen 'iCarly'!

programme.title: iCarly: Hurra, hurra, die Bude brennt!
programme.desc: Spencer versucht, Carly an ihrem Geburtstag zu überraschen, aber stattdessen setzt er ihr Zimmer in Brand. Doch als ihm die Versicherungsfirma einen dicken Scheck aushändigt, hat er die Chance, alles wiedergutzumachen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja, ich will
programme.desc: Als ein Fan von iCarly seiner Freundin in der Web-Show live einen Heiratsantrag macht, erklärt sich die Truppe bereit, zur Hochzeit zu erscheinen. Doch als die Braut kalte Füße bekommt, muss Carly den Tag retten.

programme.title: iCarly: Penny-Tees
programme.desc: Die Truppe steigt ins T-Shirt-Geschäft ein. Als die Penny-Tees zum Verkaufsschlager werden, rekrutiert Sam Viertklässler, die bei der Herstellung der Shirts helfen sollen. Doch Carly, Sam und Freddie streiten sich wegen der Arbeitsbedingungen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der König der Streiche
programme.desc: Carly gesteht, dass sie noch nie im Leben jemandem einen Streich gespielt hat. Um zu beweisen, dass sie es dennoch kann, bittet sie Spencer um Hilfe. Doch der hat damit ein gewaltiges Problem.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Mom
programme.desc: Nach einem Streit mit ihrer Mutter zieht Sam bei Carly ein. Aber Carly merkt schon bald, dass Sam ein schrecklicher Gast ist. Freddie wird von einem gefährlichen Kriminellen gestalkt, nachdem er ihn bei einem Verbrechen gefilmt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Armer Nevel
programme.desc: Als ein Video von Nevel im Internet kursiert, in dem er ein kleines Mädchen zur Schnecke macht, wird er zum Hassobjekt der Leute. Er fleht Carly und ihre Gang darum an, seine Ehre wieder herzustellen – und die lassen sich tatsächlich dazu erweichen.

programme.title: iCarly: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.sub-title: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. wollen ein wenig von der vielen Arbeit abtreten und suchen deshalb nach Praktikanten. Bei der Vorstellungsrunde tut sich besonders ein vielversprechender Nerd hervor.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Doch als dieser sie endlich zu einem Date einlädt, muss sie schockiert feststellen, dass ausgerechnet zu dieser Zeit ein großer 'iCarly'-Auftritt auf einer Comic-Messe ansteht.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Als Carly dann Adam dazu einlädt, sie auf eine Comic-Messe zu begleiten, ahnt sie allerdings noch nicht, dass sie in einen äußerst peinlichen Fan-Krieg verwickelt werden wird.

programme.title: iCarly: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Carly und ihre Freunde verbringen eine Nacht in der Schule, um ihre Schulprojekte abzuschliessen. Dabei glauben Carly und Freddie, dass sich Sam möglicherweise in den neuen Jungen namens Brad verknallt haben könnte.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 3
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: Es gibt Zoff!
programme.desc: Carly muss ständig zwischen Freddie und Sam vermitteln.

programme.title: iCarly: Die Liebe und der Wahnsinn
programme.desc: Carly findet heraus, dass Sam sich in eine Nervenheilanstalt hat einweisen lassen, weil sie glaubt, wegen ihrer Sympathie für Freddie verrückt zu sein. Da sie nicht aus der Anstalt herauskann, fragt sich die Gang, wie sie sie herausbekommen.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Oh weh, 3D!
programme.desc: Freddie will seine kreative Seite spielen lassen und entscheidet sich iCarly in 3D zu senden. Spencer stellt einen Assistenten an, den er nicht bezahlen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.sub-title: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, der bei 'Victorious' den Charakter 'Rex' spielt, interviewt die Stars von iCarly und zeigt die besten Outtakes der Staffel.

programme.title: iCarly: Action mit One Direction
programme.desc: Nach einem Urlaub hat sich Carly eine ansteckende Krankheit eingefangen. Leider steckt sie ein Mitglied der Band One Direction an. Spencer soll mit einem kleinen Mädchen trainieren, das keine Lust hat Sport zu treiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibbys Traum
programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.title: iCarly: Plötzlich Verkäuferin
programme.desc: Freddies neuer Traumjob im Pear Store wird zum Albtraum sobald Sam auch angeheuert wird. Unterdessen will Carly, dass einer ihrer Kollegen sie nach einem Date fragt und Spencer muss bei der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr ehrenamtlich arbeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Happy Hälft-o-ween!
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang schmeißt eine 'Hälft-o-ween' Party, weil Halloween so toll ist, dass es am besten zweimal im Jahr gefeiert werden sollte! Doch die Party gerät außer Kontrolle als ein kostümierter Gast Carly und ihren Freunden einen Streich spielt.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, Chuck & Spencer
programme.desc: Gibbys neues Spielzeug geht kaputt, doch Freddie repariert es ihm und legt noch einen oben drauf. Spencer versucht einem rachsüchtigen Kind mit allen Mitteln das Handwerk zu legen.

programme.title: iCarly: Hausverbot
programme.desc: Carly verbietet T-Bo einen Fuß in die Wohnung zu setzen. Er revanchiert sich, indem er sie aus dem Groovy Smoothie verbannt. Freddie und Gibby entdecken die Vorzüge einer Band anzugehören. Doch Pflichten bringt es auch mit sich.

programme.title: iCarly: Ausflug nach Vegas
programme.desc: Als Sam erfährt, dass ihre Mutter in Las Vegas im Gefängnis sitzt, packt die Truppe ihre wertvollsten Sachen ein und verpfändet sie, um Geld für die Kaution aufzutreiben. Gastdarsteller: die Besetzung der History-Channel-Serie 'Die Drei vom Pfandhaus'.

programme.title: iCarly: Brave Mädchen, böse Mädchen
programme.desc: Sams Freundin wird aus dem Jugendgefängnis entlassen, und Sam rät allen, sich von ihr fernzuhalten. Doch Carly hört nicht auf sie und traut sich zu viel zu. Im Loft findet Spencer eine Nachtsichtbrille.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 1
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 2
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.desc: En las investigaciones criminales, una pista simple puede conectar a un sospechoso con el crimen. La suciedad en los zapatos, los neumáticos, la ropa o una pequeña pieza de plástico pueden ubicar la escena del crimen.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives
programme.desc: Estos casos tardaron una década o más en resolverse. No hay un estatuto de limitaciones para asesinatos. Cuando el caso se enfría, las pistas se vuelven escasas. Los investigadores deben usar la ciencia para cerrar los casos inconclusos.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En octubre de 1995, una familia de Carolina del Sur fue tomada de rehén como parte de un robo de banco bien planificado. La policía local rápidamente identificó a dos de los criminales, pero el autor demostró ser más evasivo.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En enero de 1984, un oficial de aduanas desaparece de su puesto cerca de del río en el cruce de la frontera con Texas, incitando a la policía local a buscar a cuatro sospechosos latinoamericano. Al día siguiente, el oficial de aduanas fue hallado muerto.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: Una profesora en Washington D. C. es asesinada de disparos mientras intentaba subirse a su auto, y su cuerpo queda en el estacionamiento mientras el homicida escapa con él.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En febrero de 1996, el millonario de Nueva Jersey Frank Black viajó a Florida para cerrar un trato de negocios importante antes de su retiro.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Una familia a fuerza tiene que escoger cuando un hombre agresivo ataca. La policía sospecha al ver gente en el asiento trasero de un auto estacionado. Un reincidente se captura al momento del delito.

programme.title: China's Swan Lake
programme.desc: ‘China’s Swan Lake’ shows the lives of a whooper swan family living on the vast lake of the Sanmenxia Wetland Park along with invasive black swans and blue herons.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Caimans of the Caribbean"
Python Hunters S3 - "Death by Viper"
programme.desc: Back-to-back cold winters have been keeping Florida’s Burmese python population in check so the hunters head to Costa Rica to tangle with the region’s deadliest venomous snakes and soon find themselves on an American crocodile rescue mission.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Amazon Anaconda"
programme.desc: Putting everything on the line, the hunters head to Peru where they go off-road and off the map in search of the mighty green anaconda. Shawn has spent more than a decade exploring the jungles of Peru, buying land, and building a home away from home.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Surviving the Drought"
programme.desc: In Amboseli, the harsh drought is tightening its grip. Echo and all the elephant families go to sleep and wake up hungry. Rain is falling, but in dangerous areas, drawing elephants into increasing conflict with farmers.

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Six million metric tons of plastic end up in the world's ocean each year. Unlike other waste, plastic can stay in the water forever without breaking down. How is this deadly killer affecting the world's oceans?

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "SPITS & STINGS"
programme.desc: These creatures have evolved to incorporate spitting and stinging into their deadly arsenal for surviving in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "EJECTION & ODOR"
programme.desc: For these creatures, ejection and odour are potent instruments in capturing prey and also

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "A New Dawn"
programme.desc: Tarak is found dead and Kamal faces the prospect of leading the Galta Gang. Zamir attack's the temple again but is finally caught by the monkey catcher. New babies are born into the Galta Gang, but Zamir has also left a legacy in the city - twins!

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Divided We Stand"
programme.desc: As the troop expands and the economy plunges, scarce offerings at the temple leave the macaques competing with each other for sustenance.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Hard Times"
programme.desc: The Galta Gang splits into two troops, with Bipin, Yash and Tito leading the splinter group into the city - and into the traps of the monkey catcher.

programme.title: Feel the Heat
programme.desc: Life has harnessed the power of the sun, but the dramatic forces of fire and drought challenge the survival of plants and animals.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Misty the Owl"
programme.desc: Misty the owl is preparing for his first-ever public flight and join Highlander, a cherished police horse, as he celebrates his retirement.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Tuna Rock Cat"
programme.desc: Meet the legendary Rock Cats. The all-cat rock band stars Tuna on lead guitar and her talented daughters on the keyboard and drums.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Inti Trekking Llama"
programme.desc: Meet Inti the four-year-old llama, in training for his first-ever trek in just six weeks and Wheely Willy, a chihuahua therapist who brings joy to children everywhere.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Endangered Angel Sharks in California’s Channel Islands"
Blue World S7 - "Mysterious Lake with Non-stinging Jellyfish"
programme.desc: The Blue World team travels to Palau on an adventure to explore reefs teeming with life, plus a mysterious lake filled with thousands of harmless non-stinging jellyfish.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "World War II era Shipwrecks in Palau"
programme.sub-title: World War II era Shipwrecks in Palau
programme.desc: In the tropical paradise of Palau, the Blue World team explores World War II era shipwrecks. Then they travel to the Philippines in search of one of the rarest cephalopods in the world: the Mimic Octopus.

programme.title: Bear Whisperer S2 - "Breaking & Entering"
programme.desc: A notorious break-in bear returns to Mammoth Lakes with a cub. Steve Searles must stop her dangerous behavior before deadly consequences follow.

programme.title: Killer Instincts S1 - "Masters of their Domains"
To The Rescue S2 - "Palm Beach Pet Taxi"
To The Rescue S2 - "Houston Pets Alive!"
Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Cheetah Rescue"
Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Tooth Trouble & Game Count"
Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Preparing for the Big Release"
Paseka: The Easter Elephant
programme.desc: A baby elephant is abandoned by her herd in the wilds of Botswana’s Okavango Delta.Saved from certain death by a bizarre chain of events, she forces herself into a very unusual, captive elephant herd.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The wildlife team comes under attack from an angry rhino after releasing it from its holding crate. Our orphaned baby elephant is settling nicely into his new home and things go crazy when we introduce him to his new playmate, a sheep called Albert.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: Our vet Johan has to run for his life when a darted lion wakes up unexpectedly. The struggle continues to get our baby elephant Themba to drink milk. And the game capture team is tackling the world’s deadliest animal, the hippo.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: It’s a race against time to bring in the world’s biggest animal – the elephant. It’s gone down in a bad position and has stopped breathing. There’s a baby boom out on the reserve – we are lucky enough to watch the birth of a giraffe.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Birute Galdikas"
programme.desc: Dr. Biruté Mary Galdikas is the leading expert on orangutans, having devoted her life to saving them over the last 50 years.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Snake Invasion"
programme.desc: This time on Python Hunters… It’s a new season of hunting, and the guys are back in the Everglades to see if Florida’s bitter winter has put a serious dent in the Burmese python population.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Lizards Gone Wild"
programme.desc: In their increasing efforts to track and trap invasive species, the team is branching out, and for the first time ever they’re on the hunt for the elusive Nile monitor lizard.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Bayou Roadtrip"
programme.desc: With cold temperatures in Florida putting a freeze on python hunting, the guys head to Louisiana to conduct vital research on invasive reptile species.

programme.title: The Great Penguin Rescue S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: Michaela Strachan takes things to the next level as she signs up as a volunteer on Africa's biggest penguin rescue mission. Will Michaela be able to cope and takes on the care of hundreds of abandoned penguin chicks at the SANCCOB sea bird hospital?

programme.title: The Great Penguin Rescue S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Michaela is reaching the end of her training at the SANCCOB sea bird hospital with the angry oiled adult penguins, but just as she feels she is getting the hang of things the abandoned chicks start piling into the centre and stakes get higher.

programme.title: The Great Penguin Rescue S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: Michaela rescues two cuddly little penguin chicks, but will she be able to care for them well enough to keep them alive through their critical first two weeks?

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Responsible Fishing"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at the WWF Responsible Fisheries Programme. Dr. Samantha Petersen, the programme manager, tells exactly us what this entails and Tali dons her waterproofs and sets sail where she chats to fishermen and others in the industry.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "West Coast Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode we show just how valuable this marine protected area is.Tali meets up with a group of scientists who are doing various studies so that they can assess the fish stocks and look at what role the mpa has in managing these stocks.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Saved by the Rains"
programme.desc: On the plains of Amboseli, the rains are two months late. Echo brings the family to the palms to eat the last leaves. The wise matriarch resists the temptation to take them to inhabited areas where fresh crops are springing up and conflict waits.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Playtime"
programme.desc: In the relentless drought, the youngest calves are starving. Hunger is driving elephants to forage on surrounding farms. Echo’s keeps her family to the swamp. Rains arrive, but after five days, the much-needed downpours dwindle to sparse showers.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Clash of the Titans"
programme.desc: The rains bring new life. Lush new grass is saving the 58 elephant families from hunger. An extraordinary annual reunion brings hundreds of elephants together in scenes of celebration, play and romance.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Shark Business"
programme.desc: Shark Business unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr. Erich Ritter.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Giants of San Benedicto"
programme.desc: Giants of San Benedicto features Dr. Robert Rubin and his ground-breaking research of giant Mantas. You'll travel to the remote Socorro Islands off Mexico's Pacific coast and see breath-taking encounters with enormous manta rays.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "The Reason"
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the dynamics of the driving force of natural migrations. The seasonal movement of wild animals between pastures is a natural phenomenon, but not everywhere.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Snake Invasion"
programme.desc: This time on Python Hunters… It’s a new season of hunting, and the guys are back in the Everglades to see if Florida’s bitter winter has put a serious dent in the Burmese python population.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Lizards Gone Wild"
programme.desc: In their increasing efforts to track and trap invasive species, the team is branching out, and for the first time ever they’re on the hunt for the elusive Nile monitor lizard.

programme.title: Python Hunters S2 - "Bayou Roadtrip"
programme.desc: With cold temperatures in Florida putting a freeze on python hunting, the guys head to Louisiana to conduct vital research on invasive reptile species.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Searching for Sanctuary"
programme.desc: Rani and the temple troop rely on handouts, while Bipin and the exiles search for a new base. As prospects dim, they suddenly find a ray of hope.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Urban Exile"
programme.desc: With Jaipur overrun by langurs, the splinter group must try every trick in the book to locate food. In a faraway forest, Zamir reappears.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Street Life"
programme.desc: The remaining Galta troopers leave the temple when offerings dry up, but a close encounter with the monkey catcher sends them scurrying back home.

programme.title: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
programme.desc: Saving The Mustang explores the state of wild horses today through the efforts of three individuals. All stories interweave a compelling tale of perseverance and determination.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Odd Behavior of Hammerhead Sharks"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV explores the odd behavior of Hammerhead Sharks, goes on a Blue Hole adventure in Belize featuring a friendly shark, and takes a Deeper Dive to study Scalloped Hammerhead Sharks and Nurse Sharks.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Shark Feeding Frenzies"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV studies Whale Sharks kept in a giant tank and then takes a Deeper Dive by explaining shark hearing, shark feeding frenzies and Great White Sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Survival of the Fittest"
programme.desc: Animals adapt for survival. Crocodiles, ancient and resilient, boast slow metabolism and efficient physiology. Sharks retain successful traits over time. Whales, from land to sea, evolve with echolocation and robust anatomy, ensuring survival.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Big Cats"
programme.desc: Cheetahs race towards endangerment.Leopards thrive as opportunistic hunters.Lions reign atop the food chain. Snow leopards navigate treacherous terrain.Tigers persevere. Each big cat surviving maturity claims victory in life's relentless race.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Great Desert Race"
programme.desc: Deserts, harsh and arid, challenge life with scant rainfall. Desert animals adapt to conserve water, relying on food for hydration. They seek shade, burrow, or became nocturnal to survive extreme temperatures.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Sharks at Palau’s Blue Corner"
programme.desc: Sharks are everywhere at Palau’s famous Blue Corner, where strong currents bring in the big predators. Then the Blue World team grabs their cave diving gear and heads to the Bahamas’ Exuma Islands, on a search for a virgin ocean cave to explore.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Splendid Toadfish in Cozumel"
programme.desc: Off the island of Cozumel in Mexico, Blue World searches for a rare fish found in only two places on Earth…the Splendid Toadfish. Then the team goes cave diving in the Bahamas.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Swimming Pigs and a Mysterious Cave in the Exuma Islands"
programme.sub-title: Swimming Pigs and a Mysterious Cave in the Exuma Islands
programme.desc: In the Exuma Islands, Blue World experiences swimming pigs before exploring an underwater cave that vanishes under an island.

programme.desc: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E5 -Deadly Rivals
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E6 -Buffalo Showdown
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S2E1 -Trials of Olimba
programme.desc: Enter the heart of Zambia’s Luangwa Valley, where shady woodlands and antelope-packed plains offer the perfect hunting grounds for an audacious female leopard named Olimba and the pack she must struggle to control.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S2E2 -Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: The Nsefu lion pride welcomes seven new cubs during the wet season, when antelope and buffalo are spread far from the river, making them harder to hunt. Learn how the mother lionesses work to keep the boisterous cubs alive.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S2E3 -Kings of Nsefu
programme.desc: Twin brothers with a powerful bond have ruled the Nsefu pride for three years. They’re fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory. Witness the struggle that unfolds when rival males target their territory.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E1 -Back with the Packs
programme.desc: Return to South Luangwa to see the new pups born to the mighty Manzi and the tiny-but-fearless Kakumbi packs. See yearling Snowy face a hungry hyena before a lion pride scatters Manzi mum Weka’s pups and leaves her frantically searching for them.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances S1E1 -Into the Heat
programme.desc: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clan’s symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkat’s alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

credits.director: Patrick Morris: Executive Producers; Pierre Stine: Director

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances S1E2 -Pushed to the Limits
programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat’s strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

credits.director: Patrick Morris: Executive Producers; Pierre Stine: Director

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E4 -Chimpanzee
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he’s a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons S1E4 -Winter
programme.desc: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E3 -Heat
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E3 -The Great Escape
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

programme.desc: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sri’s plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E1 -The Invasion Begins
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E2 -Strength in Sisterhood
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad’s brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E3 -Punks on the Run
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride’s territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava’s survival skills are still intact.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E4 -The Punks Strike Back
programme.desc: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E5 -Hollywoods Held Hostage
programme.desc: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

programme.desc: A teacher's student musical to get money for his night school class of outsiders is crashed by an alien beast's rampage and a battle.

programme.title: Gamera vs. Zigra
programme.desc: The big dual-exhaust turtle chucks a boulder on the razor-sharp back fins of 75-ton monster Zigra.

programme.title: Humanoids From the Deep
programme.desc: Killer amphibians, the result of experiments splicing the genes of murderers and salmon, terrorize a small seaside community.

programme.title: Freckled Max and the Spooks
programme.desc: Young orphan Max leaves the circus to escape his abusive fosters. Taking refuge in a desolate castle, he gets acquainted with the most unlikely company: a vampire, a werewolf, the Frankenstein monster and an extraordinary old lady.

programme.title: Embryo
programme.desc: A doctor (Rock Hudson) bypasses nature with growth hormones, producing a 22-year-old (Barbara Carrera) who becomes his lover.

programme.title: Theatre of Death
programme.desc: Paris police try to unravel the sinister secret behind a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: Blood Hook
programme.desc: A killer tries to snag a Wisconsin teen and his friends during a "Muskie Madness" fishing contest.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Patrick has been in an irreversible coma for the past several years and possesses psychokinetic powers. He ends up falling in love with his new nurse, Kathy, who shows him some affection.

programme.title: Cross of the Devil
programme.desc: A writer who is plagued by violent nightmares investigates the murder of his sister by an ancient occult order.

programme.title: American Mary
programme.desc: Mary Mason (Katharine Isabelle) is lured into a world of freakish surgeries for easy money.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years after Ferdy Villiers committed suicide at the family home of Draycott Hall, the extended Villiers family gather together to celebrate Christmas. When a riddle in a Christmas cracker proclaims that two members of the family will be dead by midnight on Boxing Day, everyone takes no notice, until elderly Aunt Lydia nearly dies after getting locked in the garage, after her car has restarted itself and then later in the night, falls down the stairs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield at Cooper's Cross is where Simon Bright's vintage car is found by Frances Kirby. Inside she finds Simon dead, as the evening before his death had been on a romantic date with his girlfriend Laura Sharp. Laura is nowhere to be found, both Barnaby and Jones, newly promoted to DS, need to work out if it was a suicide pact gone wrong or whether it was murder and track down Laura.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. She receives a real shock, when she discovers that Rex's friends had been told she had died in a plane crash. Things become complicated when Rex's body is found in the nearby river. Barnaby and Jones quickly turn up trying to workout who would wish Rex harm. Several friends of Rex come forward with multiple 'new' wills each being sole beneficiary.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst on a business trip to China, Alan King suddenly dies. The family firm, King's Crystal is in financial uncertainty, including plans to close its factory in Midsomer Magna. Six months later Alan's widow Hilary and his brother Charles are married, much to the chagrin of Alan's son Ian. With family feuds and factory workers angered by the loss of their jobs, there's many motives in the mix. When Peter Baxter, the firm's accountant is found dead, stabbed with a Masonic dagger.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. The recently reformed band Hired Gun, are one of the headline acts and during their opening performance, the bands vocalist Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage whilst holding on to her microphone stand, that had an added mystery wire. Barnaby and Jones soon discover other band members could be targets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. Barnaby and Jones start investigating in Midsomer Market and discover that James may have been the intended victim. The case leads them to North Walesformer home of Delyth Mostyn, James's fiance to delve further.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the pretty village of Luxton Deeping, there's fierce conflict between the traditional film and modern digital photographers. When their societies committee decide not to accept digital images at the annual photographic exhibition, it appears to make things worse. It leads to a confrontation at the private view. The following day Lionel Bell is found murdered in woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. Not only the film crew arrive, but a notorious criminal as well, George Ince, lurking around the Manor. When Nick Cheney, the film's director is found dead, by the use of the prop guillotine. The detectives need to sift through many motives which lead to the complexity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Another attendee is Jack Colby, a disgraced ex-policeman and former colleague of Barnaby. Jack is decidedly frosty towards his once-former friend and refuses to chat. When Jack is later murdered, Barnaby must search for answers in Jack's past for motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Causton is buzzing at the opening of a new brewery on the site of a famously cursed Abbey.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter are thrust into a crime that impacts not only on their community, but internationally.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Carver Valleys comic festival is in full swing when the village is shocked by the murder of a former model.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A death at the local Rugby Club sends Barnaby and Winter into a muddle of rucks.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is less than impressed when Sarah drags him to a family friends wedding.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A man is killed after the winner of an urban myth competition gains a cult following, and myth becomes reality

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An outcast who was acquitted of murder years previously, comes under suspicion when more murders take place.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are called in to investigate a possible death by poisoning.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A scarecrow festival takes a grisly turn when dead bodies are found staged like the straw creations.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An amateur opera company is in the middle of rehearsals when a dead body is found in the theatre.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby must step into the spiritual world of mediums, psychics, and occult followers to find a killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee is jeopardised.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks.

Barbie čoskoro zistí, že pokiaľ bude načúvať svojmu srdcu a priatelia pomôžu, môže sa stať veliteľkou, na ktorú celý vesmír čakal!

programme.title: Zvedavý George - Halloweenske slávnosti
programme.desc: Halloween je takmer tu a George sa nemôže dočkať začiatku oslavy: vyrezávanie tekvíc, súťaže kostýmov a obzvlášť výročného festivalu strašenia. George a Allie, ktorí sa tešia na začiatok slávnosti, navštívia Renkinsovu farmu, aby si vybrali dokonalú tekvicu. Tu budú počuť strašidelnú povesť o No Nogginovi. Podľa povesti je No Noggin strašiak, ktorý sa objavuje na Halloween a skopáva ľuďom klobúky z hlavy. O halloweenskej noci sa George a Allie rozhodnú No Noggina odfotiť a konečne dokázať, že naozaj existuje. Dokážu získať dôkaz? To sa dozvedia len tí zvedaví!

programme.title: Barbie - Dobrodružstvo princeznej
programme.desc: Spievajte spoločne s Barbie v úplne novom muzikáli Dobrodružstvo princeznej Barbie. Dobrodružstvo začína, keď Barbie s kamarátkami cestujú do krajiny Floravia, aby sa stretli s princeznou Ameliou, ktorá sa Barbie dosť podobá. Princezná Amelia je nervózna z toho, že sa má stať kráľovnou, tak príde s plánom vymeniť si miesto s Barbie. Ich tajomstvo je v bezpečí, kým rivalský princ neodhalí pravdu. Potom už záleží len na Barbie a jej kamarátkach, aby princa zastavili a princeznú vyslobodili včas pred korunováciou. S pomocou kamarátok Barbie pomôže Amelie objaviť silu vo vlastnom hlase. Táto vzrušujúca muzikálová oslava, plná zábavných pesničiek a nových priateľov, ukazuje, že najlepšie je byť sám sebou.

programme.title: Zvedavý George - Jarné dobrodružstvá
programme.desc: Uprostred jarného upratovania v bytovke praskne potrubie, takže Vrátnik musí poslať a neochotného psa menom Hundley na vidiek spoločne s Georgom a Mužom s veľkým žltým klobúkom. Hundley sa cíti osamotený, takže George usúdi, že ten podvraťák potrebuje jarnú horúčku. Nech sa George snaží sebeviac, nepodarí sa mu jeho priateľa nakaziť. Akonáhle nastane deň závodu teplovzdušných balónov, Hundley objaví svoje korene a to môže viesť len k veselosti napriek chodníku po domove.

programme.title: Barbie Sila morských panien
programme.desc: Pridajte sa k Barbie "Brooklyn" Robertsovej, Barbie "Malibu" Robertsovej a jej sestrám Skipper, Stacie a Chelsea a prežite s nimi podmorské dobrodružstvo, pri ktorom sa premenia na morské panny, aby pomohli zachrániť svet Pacifica! V hre Barbie Mermaid Power™ sú Barbie a Barbie povolané Islou (z filmu Delfínie kúzla), aby sa stretli o úlohe podmorskej strážkyne moci v rade úloh, ktorých cieľom je nájsť svoju vnútornú silu. Vďaka týmto súťažiam zistí, či sú morské panny Zeme, Vzduchu, Vody alebo Ohňa, a pritom si nájdu nové zvieracie a morské kamarátky. V tomto vodnom príbehu o priateľstve, dobrodružstve a odvahe si Barbie, Barbie a ich rodina na vlastnej koži vyskúšajú, aké to je udržiavať rovnováhu medzi svetmi nad a pod morom, a cestou sa naučia niečo o hľadaní svojich vnútorných síl.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Hostage

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Takeover
programme.desc: A political boss hires a professional provocateur to stage a violent protest, in a maneuver to discredit his state's governor and elevate his puppet, the mayor, to the governorship in "Takeover"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Missile
programme.desc: The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blast

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Party
programme.desc: The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"

programme.title: ММА Серия – 90: Все Звезды. Н.Бархатов vs И.Фигейра
Клетка Виктории Ицеховской (MMA Серия – 90: Все Звезды)
programme.desc: В этой программе ведущая покажет вам изнутри весь масштаб и энергетику турнира по ММА. Она проведет вас за кулисы, где кипят страсти, и раскроет все тайны подготовки бойцов перед выходом на ринг. Ожесточенные тренировки, напряженные моменты ожидания и, конечно же, жаркие схватки – все это вы увидите своими глазами

programme.title: MMA Series. Вечер нокаутов: И.Харитонов, Я.Екимов, Д.Гонсалвес
Территория MMA-TV.COM ┊ 171
programme.desc: Динамичные поединки, мощные удары и неожиданные развязки ждут поклонников смешанных единоборств. Спортсмены сойдутся в напряженных противостояниях, где решающими становятся точный расчет, физическая подготовка, выдержка и умение использовать каждый шанс для победы. Россия

programme.title: MMA Series Classic. И.Варварский
programme.desc: Погрузитесь в мир смешанных единоборств, где сила, техника и выдержка определяют исход каждого поединка. Вас ждут динамичные сражения, уникальные стили ведения боя и напряженные моменты, когда спортсмены демонстрируют свои лучшие качества. Не пропустите самые зрелищные эпизоды и захватывающие баталии, которые подарят заряд адреналина и вдохновят на новые спортивные достижения

programme.title: MMA Series. Топ бойцов легчайшего веса. О.Плотник, Д.Фабриэли, И.Чернышева
programme.desc: Погрузитесь в атмосферу настоящего спортивного противостояния, где каждый раунд решает судьбу бойцов. Зрителей ждут самые зрелищные моменты, уникальные техники и тактика, а также подробный разбор событий на ринге. Узнайте, кто из бойцов легчайшего веса способен удивить публику и стать новым лидером в мире MMA. Не пропустите подборку лучших боев, где страсти кипят до последней секунды

programme.title: MMA Series Names (Н.Бархатов)

programme.title: Súper Shore

programme.title: Súper Shore

programme.title: Súper Shore

इवनिंग प्राइम
ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Evening Prime
इवनिंग प्राइम
ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: The Recon
programme.desc: One day at early dawn a search unit near the DMZ the front line is on alert. It was because a soldier from another unit’s GP ran away to DMZ with a gun. Under Commander Baek the 3rd platoon members led by First Lieutenant Cho are put into the operation to arrest the deserter. The search begins and at the same time First Lieutenant Lim's dead body is found at the unit’s official residence. The accident is reported to the Division Headquarters and Captain Kang who is about to be discharged arrives at the search unit with an army surgeon. The commander and the army surgeon are rushing to conclude Lim’s case with suicide but Kang suspects that there is a deep secret in this accident. At that time the soldiers who were put into the operations get killed one by one and the dark truth between Lim’s death and the deserter search operation is revealed.

programme.title: Drama Serial 'Blossom' E27
programme.desc: Inspired by the life of renowned novelist Uno Chiyo, who pursued freedom throughout the Meiji, Taisho, and Showa eras, this drama tells the story of Hano Tama (Ishibashi Shizuka). Born in Yamaguchi Prefecture in 1897, Tama moves to Tokyo and rekindles her childhood dream of becoming a writer. Through disasters, war, turbulent relationships, and financial struggles, she remains true to herself and forges her own path, eventually becoming a celebrated novelist whose life and work inspire generations.

programme.title: Drama Serial 'Blossom' and Uno Chiyo: Women Who Paved The Way For A New Era
programme.desc: To coincide with NHK's drama serial 'Blossom', this special event explores the life and legacy of novelist Uno Chiyo, the model for the series heroine. A pioneering woman who forged her own path and lived life on her own terms, Uno continues to inspire people today. Featuring rare archival footage and recordings, the event also examines the appeal of 'Blossom' and includes a discussion by producers of previous drama serials on how the image of the morning drama heroine has evolved over the years.

programme.title: The Making Of The Theme Song For Drama Serial 'Blossom'
programme.desc: Ishibashi Shizuka, who stars as Hano Tama, sits down for her first-ever conversation with YOASOBI, creators of the drama's theme song. Together, they discuss the inspiration behind the song and how it encouraged Ishibashi throughout filming. The program also goes behind the scenes of the opening title sequence, with choreographer Tsujimoto Tomohiko sharing the story behind the dance. An emotional surprise from YOASOBI awaits.

programme.title: Drama 10 'The Employee' E4
programme.desc: Miyaki Eriko (Yoshida Yoh), a 50-year-old company employee, has climbed the ranks in a male-dominated workplace, driven by ambition. Success on her current project will finally earn her a long-awaited promotion to the board. But just before its launch, she receives an anonymous threat. As she confronts the person behind it, Eriko comes face to face with the deep-rooted problems within the organization and the pain they cause.

programme.title: Night Drama Serial 'The Blue Flowers And The Ceramic Forest' E6
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
programme.desc: Der Schrumpf-Tag / Gefängnisstrafe - SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. programme.title: Willkommen bei den Louds
programme.desc: Der Schulausflug / Das Traumauto - Der elf Jahre alte Lincoln Loud lebt zusammen mit seinen zehn Schwestern, fünf älteren und fünf jüngeren, in einem Haus. Als einziger Junge muss er viel ertragen. Mutter und Vater stehen dabei nicht immer hinter ihm. Jede Schwester hat eine spezielle Eigenschaft. Lincoln hat einen sehr guten Freund. Sie gehen zusammen zur Schule. Zu Beginn der Serie steht Lincoln im Mittelpunkt. Fast alles spielt sich im Haus ab. Später kommen andere Figuren und Orte wie die Schule hinzu. Nach und nach lernt man Nachbarn, Freunde und das Personal der Schule kennen.

programme.desc: Alles auf Neu! - Als Lincoln versucht, die Klasse zu wechseln, weil er von seiner Gang getrennt wurde, wird er nach Kanada versetzt. Lori fühlt sich auf keiner Etage des Studentenwohnheims wohl. Mom und Dad müssen Lily für die Kita ans Töpfchen gewöhnen.

programme.title: Willkommen bei den Louds
programme.desc: Nachbarn zum Gruseln / Zur Schnecke gemacht - Grouse versucht alles, um Lance und seine Familie wieder aus Royal Woods zu vertreiben, nachdem sie nebenan eingezogen sind. Nachdem Lynn eine Online-Sportshow veröffentlicht hat, lernt sie schnell, wie sich mehr Klicks und Fans generieren lassen.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
programme.desc: Das große Zugabenteuer - SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier
programme.desc: Neujahrsvorsätze / Der Buchclub - Schere tut alles, um seine nicht eingehaltenen guten Neujahrsvorsätze umzusetzen, damit er sich Papier gegenüber nicht mehr schlecht fühlt. Um sich klug vorzukommen, gründet Papier einen Buchclub mit den am wenigsten intelligenten Mitgliedern.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Krieg der Stufen / Frostige Feinde - Der junge Patrick lebt in einem Haus mit seinen Eltern und den Groß-Eltern. Der Junge träumt davon, ein erfolgreicher Entertainer zu werden. Um seinem Ziel näher zu kommen, veranstaltet er seine eigene Show in seinem Kinder-Zimmer und nimmt das Geschehen mit der Kamera auf. Seine kleine Schwester steht dem Teenager dabei hilfreich zur Seite. Die Themen seiner Sendung wechseln häufig. Während der Produktion seiner Show erlebt Patrick zahlreiche Abenteuer. Dabei spielen oft auch die Menschen in seiner Familie eine Rolle.

programme.title: Pinky Malinky¿
programme.desc: Hater / Video - In dieser Social-Media-inspirierten Mockumentary begleiten wir den positiven Hotdog Pinky dabei, wie er und seine beiden besten Freunde den Schulalltag navigieren und beweisen, dass "Wiener" und "Gewinner" praktisch das gleiche sind!

programme.title: Willkommen bei den Louds
programme.desc: Shane muss sich entscheiden - Der elf Jahre alte Lincoln Loud lebt zusammen mit seinen zehn Schwestern, fünf älteren und fünf jüngeren, in einem Haus. Als einziger Junge muss er viel ertragen. Mutter und Vater stehen dabei nicht immer hinter ihm. Jede Schwester hat eine spezielle Eigenschaft. Lincoln hat einen sehr guten Freund. Sie gehen zusammen zur Schule. Zu Beginn der Serie steht Lincoln im Mittelpunkt. Fast alles spielt sich im Haus ab. Später kommen andere Figuren und Orte wie die Schule hinzu. Nach und nach lernt man Nachbarn, Freunde und das Personal der Schule kennen.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Spurensuche - Nach ihrem gescheiterten Versuch, Besucher anzulocken, sind die Arondekars damit beschäftigt, ihre Frühstückspension einzurichten, als sie durch den von Termiten zerfressenen Fußboden brechen. Jay fragt sich, ob er seit dem Vorfall ähnliche Gaben wie seine Frau haben könnte, wie im Teaser angedeutet. In Staffel 2 treffen wir auf neue Gastfiguren, tot und lebend, und wir erfahren, wie Thorfinns alter nordischer Fluch wirklich beeinflusst.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Flucht von welcher Insel? - Bob Belcher ist Gastronom in dritter Generation und betreibt das Restaurant Bob's Burgers mit seiner schrulligen Frau Linda und drei Kindern. Bob glaubt, dass seine Burger für sich selbst sprechen, und scheut sich nicht davor, eine Vielzahl von ausgefallenen Kreationen anzubieten. Bobs Frau unterstützt seinen Traum, hat aber die Nase voll von den schwierigen Zeiten, da das Restaurant ständig in Gefahr ist, den Betrieb einzustellen. Trotz der Herausforderungen versucht Bob, den Grill am Brutzeln zu halten.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Das Kochduell - Am 31. Dezember 1999 beginnt für die Wissenschaft und für den fünfundzwanzigjährigen New Yorker Lieferjungen Fry ein spannendes Experiment. Fry wird versehentlich eingefroren und wacht genau 1000 Jahre später wieder im futuristischen Neu New York auf. Doch nicht nur die Stadt hat sich verändert. Fry, der schon dem 20. Jahrhundert nicht gewachsen war, fällt es anfangs nicht leicht, sich auf die völlig neuen Erdbewohner einzustellen. Doch schon bald arbeitet er wieder in seinem alten Job. Diesmal allerdings bei Planet Express, einem intergalaktischen Liefer-Service. Mit seinen neuen Freunden Leela, einer außerirdischen Zyklopin, und dem entarteten Roboter Bender erkundet er das Universum ...

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Das Oberwalross - Stan Smith (Seth MacFarlane) ist ein Amerikaner wie er im Buche steht, ein American Dad eben. Als Experte für Waffen ist er bei der CIA immer auf den Fall eines terroristischen Anschlags vorbereitet und würde so ziemlich alles dafür tun, sein geliebtes Vaterland, die USA, zu beschützen. Aber neben seinem Beruf ist er vor allem eins: ein Familienmensch. Nach außen hin sind die Smiths also eine ganz normale Familie, so scheint es, wären da nicht neben dem pubertierenden Sohn Steve (Scott Grimes) und der ultra-liberalen Tochter Hayley (Rachael MacFarlane) die Familienmitglieder Roger und Klaus. Roger, ein Außerirdischer, wurde von Stan einst aus der Area 51 vor dem sicheren Tod gerettet, ...

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mysterion schlägt zurück - Die preisgekrönte, gesellschaftskritische Erfolgsserie von Matt Stone und Trey Parker erzählt die Geschichte von den vier frühreifen Grundschülern Stan Marsh, Kyle Broflovski, Kenny McCormick und Eric Cartman im US-amerikanischen Bergstädtchen South Park, Colorado.Alle von ihnen sehen niedlich aus wie die Heinzelmännchen, sind in Wahrheit aber vollkommen durchgeknallte Charaktere. Radikaler Zeichentrick-Witz und bitterböse Dialoge jenseits des schwarzen Humors von Mony Python zeichnen die Serie aus. Stan reihert gern seine Freundin voll, Kyle kreuzt einen Elefanten mit einem Schwein und Kenny stirbt in beinahe jeder Folge einen blutigen Tod. Und nicht zu vergessen, Cartman, der feiert ...

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: Die Monster-Party - Im Mittelpunkt dieser Animationsserie steht der verrückte, aber geniale Wissenschaftler Rick und dessen 14-jähriger ängstlicher Enkel Morty, der ihn auf seinen urkomischen interdimensionalen Reisen durch die Galaxie und die Zeit begleitet. Dabei stiften das alkoholkranke Genie und sein leicht unterbelichteter Nachfahre jede Menge Chaos und geraten ständig in Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: The Daily Social Distancing Show/Jon Stewart - Jon Stewart und das furchtlose News-Team der Daily Show widmen sich den größten Schlagzeilen des Tages - mit unerschrockener Berichterstattung, professionellen Analysen und sachlichen Stellungnahmen.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
programme.desc: Der blaue Geist - Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt. Aang ist nicht nur der letzte Herrscher über die Luft, sondern auch der Avatar, der Herr über alle Elemente. Er ist derjenige, der über die Form von Wasser, Erde, Luft und Feuer bestimmt. Doch der Avatar war 100 Jahre lang in einem Gletscher am Südpol eingefroren, und während dieser Zeit sind die Herrscher des Feuers ihrem Ziel der totalen Weltherrschaft immer näher gekommen. Erst als Aang von Katara, der letzten Gebieterin des Wassers, und deren Bruder Sokka aus dem ewigen Eis befreit wird, hat er eine Chance, seine Mission ...

Bobs Frau unterstützt seinen Traum, hat aber die Nase voll von den schwierigen Zeiten, da das Restaurant ständig in Gefahr ist, den Betrieb einzustellen. programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Gebell aus der Steinzeit - Am 31. Dezember 1999 beginnt für die Wissenschaft und für den fünfundzwanzigjährigen New Yorker Lieferjungen Fry ein spannendes Experiment. Fry wird versehentlich eingefroren und wacht genau 1000 Jahre später wieder im futuristischen Neu New York auf. Doch nicht nur die Stadt hat sich verändert. Fry, der schon dem 20. Jahrhundert nicht gewachsen war, fällt es anfangs nicht leicht, sich auf die völlig neuen Erdbewohner einzustellen. Doch schon bald arbeitet er wieder in seinem alten Job. Diesmal allerdings bei Planet Express, einem intergalaktischen Liefer-Service. programme.title: Futurama
